steps.description: AC-1: Confirm `/auto` defines explicit `start-from=<phase>` using canonical phase IDs.
AC-2: Confirm deterministic resume resolution order is `argument > handoffs/resume_brief.md > docs/engineering/state.md > fail-fast`.
AC-3: Confirm missing/stale/conflicting/unparseable resume sources fail safely with actionable `[AUTO_RESUME_ERROR]` guidance.
AC-4: Confirm one `/auto` invocation continues remaining phases from the resolved mid-process start point.
AC-5: Confirm continuation preserves existing stop conditions (decision gate, missing critical input, pause request, loop max cycles).
AC-6: Confirm deterministic breadcrumb fields are written for requested/resolved start phase, source, stop reason, stop phase, and timestamp.
AC-7: Confirm default-safe behavior remains unchanged for manual/interactive workflows unless continuation mode is explicitly used.
AC-8: Confirm `/pause`, `/resume`, and `/auto` guidance is semantically aligned for shared continuation semantics.
AC-9: Confirm active and template continuation guidance files remain aligned for the US-0037 contract.
